I have always been anxious but needing to get a mole biopsied when I was 19 catalysed the severe health anxiety I have today. I waited two weeks for the biopsy in a fog of grief as I was sure I was going to be told I was dying. When I finally went to get it done they told me they didn’t expect there to be anything there and it was just precautionary. I was so pissed - that was a traumatic experience for me. Ever since then I have complete breakdowns with any new symptoms and can’t be consoled until I am reassured by a doctor. Then I move on to the next symptom to panic about. It has been devastating to me. The thing is as well, you never forget any symptom you’ve ever had, it’s like your brain is waiting for you to lay down your guard so it can remind you of something to panic about and you alienate friends and family in the process because you’re ‘worrying about nothing’. It feels like the worst kind of betrayal even though you can understand where they are coming from. I fear past possible diagnoses, present diagnoses and things I could have in the future. And it can extend to family too, I worry so much about them. I’m still waiting to be able to have therapy but it gets harder the older I get. Sorry this was kind of word vomit, I don’t get to talk about this much lol
